DRAW_AND_GUESS_MOD_RELIC_DEATH_NOTE.desc: You can [gold]Draw[/gold] at Rest Sites. Cards you draw disappear completely from this run. Upon pickup, obtain a random [red]Curse[/red].
DRAW_AND_GUESS_MOD_RELIC_DEATH_NOTE.flav: Heard that in another world, there is also a similar notebook.
DRAW_AND_GUESS_MOD_RELIC_MEMORIAL_SKETCH: Keeps every card drawing made by every player this run. Browse it to choose permanent card artwork.
DRAW_AND_GUESS_MOD_MEMORIAL_SKETCHBOOK_C: Left-click to inspect. Enable Set as Permanent Artwork, then select a drawing to replace its card art.
